facts.business: Reliance Industries Limited operates an integrated energy and materials business (Oil to Chemicals, Oil and Gas), digital services (Jio), and retail (Reliance Retail), and is developing a clean energy ecosystem.

auditor.name: Deloitte Haskins & Sells LLP and Chaturvedi & Shah LLP
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: The Secretarial Audit Report and Corporate Governance compliance certificate do not contain any qualification, reservation, adverse remark or disclaimer.

key_risks: Strategic and Commercial risks including Cybersecurity, Safety and Operations, Compliance, Control and Financial risks
Market volatility and sudden market volatility
Execution risk on large capital expenditure projects (solar PV and battery gigafactories)
Refinancing risk for scheduled debt maturities
facts.related_party_note: Working Capital Loans from Banks of Rs 12,351 crore (Previous Year Rs 7,371 crore) are secured by hypothecation of present and future stock of raw materials, work-in-progress, finished goods, stores and spares (not relating to plant and machinery), book debts, outstanding monies, receivables, claims, bills, materials in transit, fixed deposit etc. save and except stock and receivables of Oil & Gas segment.
